Lease Abstraction 4: 
THIS LEASE AGREEMENT (the "Agreement") is made and entered into this seventeenth day of July, two thousand twenty-six, by and between the Landlord and Glow Hair Salon (hereinafter referred to as "Tenant"), regarding the real property located at 12 Beauty Blvd (the "Premises").
The term of this lease shall commence on January 1, 2027, and shall continue for a period of forty-eight full calendar months, expiring on December 31, 2030. In consideration for the rights of use and occupancy granted under this Agreement, Tenant covenants to pay to the Landlord, without notice, demand, deduction, or set-off, a monthly base rent in the amount of Two Thousand Eight Hundred and 00/100 Dollars. Said payments shall be remitted in advance on or before the first business day of each calendar month. Commencing on the first anniversary of the Commencement Date, and on each successive anniversary thereafter throughout the duration of this Agreement, the monthly base rent shall be subject to a fixed escalation adjustment. Specifically, the rent shall be increased by an amount equal to five percent of the then-current monthly base rent. This adjusted figure shall thereafter constitute the base rent for the subsequent twelve-month period.
In addition to the base consideration stipulated above, Tenant shall be responsible for its proportional share of all operational, management, and maintenance expenses incurred by the Landlord in the preservation and repair of the building and its appurtenant common areas. Such additional rent shall be billed on a pro-rata basis and shall be payable within fifteen days of receipt of an invoice detailing the associated expenditures.
Provided that the Tenant is not in default of any covenants or obligations contained herein beyond any applicable cure periods, the Tenant shall be granted a single option to extend the duration of this occupancy for one subsequent period of two years. To validly exercise this extension privilege, the Tenant must provide definitive written intent to the Landlord no later than one hundred eighty days prior to the initial expiration date specified above, failing which this option shall automatically lapse and be deemed null, void, and of no further legal effect.

model_output.escalation: 5% annual increase on each anniversary of the Commencement Date
model_output.cam: Tenant responsible for proportional share of operational, management, and maintenance expenses; payable within 15 days of invoice
model_output.renewal_option: One option to extend for 2 years; requires written notice 180 days prior to expiration
key_provisions: Rent payable in advance on or before first business day of each month
No deduction or set-off permitted for rent payments
Extension option lapses if not exercised timely
Tenant must not be in default to exercise renewal option
